def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Third-order voltage-controlled-current function.
       Compatible with both n-type and p-type semiconductors.
    """
    kp, vth, gm = parameters[0], parameters[1], parameters[2]
    log_id = -kp * np.log(1 + np.exp((gate_voltage_abs - vth) / (gm * drain_voltage_abs)))
    return 10 ** log_id
